questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'India has started the largest inoculation drive in the world against Covid.'

Key Points

  • Among the given options the correctly spelt sentence is Option 2.
  • The word that has been incorrectly spelt in other options is 'Inoculation'.
  • The meaning of the word 'Inoculation' in Hindi is 'टीकाकरण' and in English, it means the process of injecting a vaccine to provide immunity against a disease.
    • Example: I received an inoculation against the flu before the winter season started.
       

Thus, India has started the largest inoculation drive in the world against Covid the correct answer.

questions.questionHtml:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

The poor woman is in excruciating mental anguish, and her loved ones appear to have assisted in exarcerbating her traumatic experiences.
questions.solution: Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is 'exarcerbating'. Its correct spelling is 'Exacerbating' which means making a problem, situation, or feeling worse or more severe. Example: His constant criticism and negativity were exacerbating the already tense situation at work.

Key Points

  • Let us explore the meaning of the given options
    • accommodate -  (of a building or other area) provide lodging or sufficient space for.
    • flapped - (of a bird) move (its wings) up and down when flying or preparing to fly.
    • referred - mention or allude to.
    • noncomital -There is no such word in English or we can say that there is a spelling mistake in the word.

Additional Information 
  • If we double the letters m and t in the word noncomital, we get the word noncommittal.
  • Noncommittal is a proper English word and it means not expressing or revealing commitment to a definite opinion or course of action.
